summary: None of the new user-facing commands is documented: fix adapt/liggghts, dump hdf5, dump mesh/hdf5, cohesion generalized_adhesion, v_ values and 'every N' in fix property/global
failure_scenario: A user reading doc/fix_property.txt or doc/Section_commands cannot discover the v_ syntax, units of adhesionEnergy (Pa not J/m2, see C-07), or that fix adapt/liggghts ignores max radius (F-03); grep of doc/ for adapt/liggghts, hdf5, generalized_adhesion returns nothing
evidence_ref: grep -rli 'adapt/liggghts|hdf5|generalized_adhesion' doc/ -> empty; doc/fix_property.txt has no v_/every
recommendation: Add doc/fix_adapt_liggghts.txt, doc/dump_hdf5.txt, doc/gran_cohesion_generalized_adhesion.txt and a v_/every section in doc/fix_property.txt with units, valid ranges and restrictions

summary: EASO doc still describes the removed scalar surfaceTension property; the code now requires peratomtypepair surfaceEnergy (see C-08/C-09)
failure_scenario: Following the shipped documentation produces an abort at init
recommendation: Update doc and add a deprecation error that names the new property

summary: All 9 new source files (fix_adapt_liggghts.*, dump_hdf5.*, dump_mesh_hdf5.*, cohesion_model_generalized_adhesion.h, aligned_particle_soa.h, contact_model_crtp_api.h) carry no license/copyright header, unlike every upstream file (GPL-2+ banner + contributing author)
failure_scenario: Redistribution of the fork mixes GPL-2+ files with files of unstated license and authorship; downstream packagers/ journals cannot establish provenance
recommendation: Add the standard LIGGGHTS GPL-2-or-later banner, a copyright line and 'Contributing author' block to each new file; consider SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later

summary: No top-level .gitignore; build/ (164 MB), generated .h5/.xdmf outputs (~80 MB in chute_wear/post and chute_wear_hpc/post), log.liggghts files and a stray object file h5inspect_chute.o are all untracked-but-not-ignored and appear in git status
failure_scenario: A routine 'git add -A' commits ~250 MB of binaries and outputs; the deleted examples/.../chute_wear/post/.gitignore means a fresh clone has no post/ directory (see F-29)
evidence_ref: git status; du -sh build examples/.../post; git check-ignore returns nothing
recommendation: Add root .gitignore (build*/, *.o, log.liggghts, *.h5, *.xdmf, examples/**/post/*), restore post/.gitignore placeholder, delete h5inspect_chute.o

summary: Test suite consists of a single regression deck, which does not reach its asserted error (see C-05/P0-04); no unit tests for contact models, no CTest integration, no CI configuration (.github absent)
failure_scenario: Every regression found in this audit (C-01, F-02, F-03, C-02) would have shipped undetected; there is no automated gate
recommendation: Add CTest with (a) contact-level unit harnesses (audit/scripts/contact/ can seed them), (b) Chung & Ooi decks with numeric tolerances, (c) 1/2/4-rank smoke; run in GitHub Actions on every PR

summary: Build is split: HDF5 only via Makefile.hdf5mpi, CMake has no LIGGGHTS_HDF5/SoA options, CMake globs src/ including src/GPU_DEM, writes generated style_*.h into the source tree and forces -ffast-math for GCC
failure_scenario: Out-of-tree CMake builds pollute src/; -ffast-math silently changes contact-model rounding and NaN handling (the audit had to add -fno-fast-math); feature set of a binary depends on which build route was used
recommendation: Add CMake options (LIGGGHTS_ENABLE_HDF5, LIGGGHTS_USE_SOA_NVE), CMakePresets.json (release/debug-asan/reldeb), generate style headers into the binary dir, drop -ffast-math by default, exclude src/GPU_DEM unless enabled
